boundary: No equivariant bijection to a specific labelled tomotope flag set and no canonical partition of all 2880 events into fifteen disjoint 192-event packets is claimed.

new_synthesis.canonical_15_by_96_relation: The unique-max relation is a canonical S6-invariant 15-duad-by-96 event incidence.
new_synthesis.consequence: The 192 tight-frame redundancy is genuinely resolved into tomotope-sized 96 layers, but this incidence datum alone does not canonically choose the tomotope two-flag-orbit pair.
new_synthesis.three_96_relations: All three profile relations have exactly 96 incidences at every residual duad.

theorem: The curved-event/tomotope coincidence is stronger than 2880=15*192: exceptional-S6 incidence with the 15 residual duads yields three exact 96-valent relations, each the size of one tomotope flag orbit. Any two give 192 incidences per duad, but the geometry supplies three natural choices, exposing a precise canonical-selection obstruction.
